summary: Trekor Metals Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing Q2 2026 production results for its wholly-owned Gibraltar mine and Florence Copper facility. The release reports 30.3 million lbs copper and 559,000 lbs molybdenum from Gibraltar, and 5.2 million lbs cathode from Florence, with annual guidance unchanged. No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change) is present. This is a routine operational update disclosing production metrics. No deal terms are applicable.
